column2: (4) The members of the body corporate shall at all times
be subject to the rules of the body corporate.
8. The Committee shall maintain a register of members
in  which  name,  address  and  other  essential  details  of  the
members, a register of appointments of the members of the
Executive  Committee,  participation  of  the  members  of  the
Executive  Committee  in  its  meetings  or  general  meetings
and resolutions passed in those meetings and other essential
information related thereto shall be inscribed.
